section_intro:
SLSQ327R270
The Demand Gen Programs team works directly with Databricks' Sales Development and Sales leaders to build a world-class top-of-funnel engine.
We give every xDR and AE the programs, plays and insights they need to turn market potential into predictable pipeline and revenue.
We work where strategy, AI and the field meet.
We own the programs that are moving scaled, AI-native demand gen from an experiment to the way Databricks prospects by default.
We're hiring a Manager, Demand Gen programs to own demand gen programs across our APJ business.
That covers markets as different as ANZ, Japan, Korea, India and ASEAN, each with its own buyers, languages and ways of selling.
You'll be the APJ Sales Development organization's strategic and operational partner, and the role has three core pillars:
Run demand gen programs end to end : Be a true business partner to Sales Development leadership.
You'll design, align, prioritize, launch, report on and inspect the global and regional demand gen programs that run in APJ.
You'll turn global programs into regional versions that work in each market, and you'll run day-to-day program management with real rigor: cadences, timelines, owners and follow-through.
Agentify programs: Teach our AI demand gen platform how to prospect.
You'll build agentic plays for different scenarios: defining account and contact targeting criteria, researching the messaging and content that work with APJ buyers, and curating industry- and market-specific content and use cases.
You'll work with Enablement to roll these plays out to the field and make sure they're actually adopted, not just launched.
Keep improving programs: Use data to judge whether programs are working.
You'll define success metrics, separate what works from what doesn't, run A/B tests on messaging, targeting and sequence design, and make data-driven recommendations and pivots.
You'll close the loop so that what we learn goes back into program design and into the agents themselves.
Alongside Sales Development leadership, you'll work with Sales Programs, Strategy & Operations, Enablement, Marketing, Industry teams and Analytics to plan and prioritize programs, curate content and drive adoption.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter with endless curiosity who works across teams to solve complex problems end to end.
You're AI-fluent, operationally rigorous and opinionated about how high-volume demand gen should run.
You'd rather redesign a workflow from first principles than maintain a legacy one.
This is a rare chance to define what scaled, AI-native demand gen looks like at one of the fastest-growing companies in tech, and to set the blueprint for the industry.
The impact you'll have
Own Demand Gen Programs for all of APJ.
That includes outcomes and inspection, metric design, measurement and reporting, governance, benchmarking, enablement, content strategy and change management.
Shape the AI demand gen product roadmap.
Bring field feedback and APJ needs to the product team.
Feed the platform the content, criteria and plays that make it Databricks' core demand gen engine for both Sales and Sales Development.
Drive prioritization and alignment.
Run regular cadences with Sales Development and Sales Strategy leaders across APJ to gather feedback, set priorities and run programs, including SPIFs, contests, pipeline reviews and reporting reviews.
Own reporting and inspection.
Build the data foundation and the executive- and field-facing reporting that shows what works and what doesn't across sequences, tactics, personas, segments and markets.
Turn that reporting into clear decisions, not just dashboards.
Own sequence governance.
Standardize, audit and manage Outreach sequences on an ongoing basis, both AI-driven and manual.
Review design and effectiveness centrally, retire underperformers and scale what works.
Be a force multiplier.
Bring fresh thinking to old problems, build AI-powered toolkits and workflows that scale beyond you, and raise the technical bar for the whole team.
Connect the pieces.
Integrate demand gen programs with broader Sales, Marketing and Industry programs so the field gets one coherent motion.
Own the feedback loop between the field, the programs and the platform.
section_responsibilities:
First 30 days: You know the APJ Sales Development org, its leaders and the current program portfolio.
You've set up a regular operating cadence with regional leadership, baselined the core program metrics, and delivered at least one quick win, such as a cleaned-up sequence library or a new inspection view.
First 90 days: You've launched agentic plays tuned to APJ markets, run structured A/B tests that produced clear learnings, and set up a trusted, single source of truth for program reporting across the region.
First 9 months: Scaled, AI-native demand gen is the default operating model in APJ.
Coverage, conversion and xDR productivity have improved measurably, and the playbooks you built are being reused in other regions.
What we look for
AI fluency is non-negotiable.
AI tools are part of how you work every day.
You can show where they've multiplied your output.
A "built something from nothing" background.
Strong examples include program or GTM strategy at a hypergrowth company, owning Sales Development or demand gen programs, or consulting followed by hands-on operating experience.
We want people who thrive where no playbook existed yet, and who wrote one.
Exceptional attention to detail and instinct for data integrity.
The role needs consistent, high-quality delivery: accurate exec-facing work, on-time delivery, honest status and zero-defect output.
You spot discrepancies, trace them to the root cause, and won't ship a number you can't defend.
Program ownership.
You want to do the operational parts of the job, not just design them.
A strategic view of high-volume demand gen.
You have a point of view on how scaled coverage, AI pilots and programmatic engagement should work.
You want to redefine the demand gen operating model, not maintain it.
Comfort with ambiguity.
The role doesn't come with a finished playbook.
The right person is energized by that, not thrown by it.
Technical depth.
You're strong in SQL, comfortable with newer data and AI tools (Databricks SQL, Genie, custom agents), and learn fast.
You can translate business needs into technical requirements and back again.
A "get it done" attitude.
You can set program strategy and also execute it with close attention to detail.
Collaboration.
You do well in collaborative teams.
Regional and cross-cultural range.
You've worked across APJ markets or with distributed, multicultural teams.
You're comfortable working across time zones and adapting programs to local buying behavior.
Excellent spoken and written communication.
You present regularly and confidently to senior leaders from many cultures.
You produce leader-ready decks, executive summaries and quantitative business cases.
GTM tools proficiency. hands-on experience with Outreach, Salesforce or similar sales engagement and CRM tools; experience designing experiments or A/B tests; experience in data, AI or enterprise software sales.
What this role isn't
Not a pure strategy role.
If you want to think but not execute, this isn't the role for you.
The operational work (cadences, reporting, governance) isn't optional.
It's where much of the impact comes from.
Not a role for maintaining the current model.
We need someone who will challenge how demand gen works in the age of AI and rebuild it from first principles.
Not a role for anyone uncomfortable with volume, ambiguity or pace.
These programs touch the entire APJ Sales Development org, and the pace of work reflects that.

We manage the infrastructure efficiency for one of the world's largest data and AI platforms.
Operating at massive scale across AWS, Azure, and GCP, our mission is to ensure that every dollar spent on cloud infrastructure is optimized.
The MCE team builds the critical tools, frameworks, and automated systems that provide deep cost visibility and ensure maximum resource utilization.

You will be responsible for defining the technical strategy for efficiency projects where the solutions are not yet known.

Operational Excellence: Serve as a technical authority for incident management, addressing complex, system-wide performance issues.
You will improve the stability and reliability of our internal platform tools, ensuring they are robust enough to manage our growing global scale.
Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier by mentoring junior and senior engineers, raising the bar for engineering quality, and driving engineering culture across the organization.

Proven track record of architecting solutions for large-scale infrastructure, cloud computing (AWS/Azure/GCP), and container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker).
Deep expertise in identifying and solving performance bottlenecks in high-throughput, distributed environments.
Demonstrated ability to drive technical requirements for ambiguous problems where the path forward is not obvious.
T-shaped engineering skills: depth in distributed systems and breadth across cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and software lifecycles.

section_about:
The Agentic Security Engineering team is a horizontal, shared services engineering team that enables every Databricks security function AI-native.
We enable building the AI agents, "personas," and own the shared platform that security teams across the org (Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability & Product Security, Red Team, GRC, and Continuous Monitoring) build on to operate at machine speed, safely and reliably.
We leverage AI to transform how security is done.
section_responsibilities:
As a Senior Staff Security Software Engineer on the Agentic Security Engineering team, you will be a senior technical authority and architect for Databricks' shared Security AI platform.
You will define the platform architecture, technical standards, and multi-year engineering direction that allow security teams to build, deploy, and operate governed AI personas safely at scale.
Your work will span secure agent identity, isolation and sandboxing, policy enforcement, auditability, observability, evaluation, orchestration, and reliable integration with Databricks and security infrastructure.
You will operate across organizational boundaries, aligning engineering and security leaders on platform architecture, driving adoption of common patterns, and resolving complex technical problems that affect multiple security functions.
You will influence the quality, safety, reliability, and velocity of the broader Security AI ecosystem without owning the domain logic or business outcomes of every individual persona.
The Impact You Will Have
Shared Security AI Platform Architecture
Define and evolve the architecture for the shared Security AI platform and its paved road for governed agentic workflows.
Establish reusable patterns for agent identity, least-privilege access, sandboxing, egress control, secret isolation, policy enforcement, auditability, and rollback.
Set engineering standards for reliability, observability, evaluation, incident response, cost instrumentation, and safe production deployment.
Make high-leverage build, buy, and adopt decisions that keep the platform focused on security-specific capabilities while using Databricks platform primitives wherever they meet the need.
Design the platform to support secure multi-agent workflows, tool registries, policy-aware orchestration, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
Reliable and Safe Agentic Systems at Scale
Lead the design and development of production-grade platform capabilities that enable security personas to operate reliably across a growing AI and security surface.
Define how the platform measures successful runs, latency, failure rates, rollback readiness, safety, governance coverage, trust, autonomy, and business value.
Establish qualification and maturity mechanisms that determine what a security persona may do, what controls it requires, and how it earns additional autonomy.
Drive technical solutions for high-risk workflows, including offensive security personas, untrusted inputs, sensitive data, production access, and automated tool execution.
Improve the velocity of safe AI development without compromising security, governance, or operational reliability.
Cross-Organizational Technical Leadership
Serve as a technical authority for the shared Security AI platform across Security Operations, Product Security, Governance and Risk, Compliance and Assurance, Enterprise Security, and other partner functions.
Align engineering and security leaders on platform direction, architectural tradeoffs, adoption priorities, and standards for safe agentic systems.
Partner with AI Champions and domain teams to turn recurring cross-functional needs into reusable platform capabilities.
Represent the platform in architecture reviews and technical decisions involving agent identity, isolation, policy, observability, evaluation, orchestration, and secure integration.
Drive adoption of common platform patterns and retire duplicated or inconsistent implementations across security teams.
Mentorship and Team Capability
Mentor engineers on distributed systems, platform architecture, AI security engineering, agentic threat modeling, and technical leadership.
Lead high-rigor design reviews and raise the bar for reliability, operability, security, and maintainability.
Help establish a culture of measurable outcomes, disciplined evaluation, safe experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Influence technical direction beyond the immediate team through clear written proposals, architecture reviews, and cross-functional execution.

What it takes to thrive
Databricks is a deeply technical, fast-moving environment, and our GTM organization is a key engine of our growth.
You'll partner with dynamic, data-driven leaders who value rigorous analysis, clear perspectives, and collaborative problem-solving.
In this role, priorities can evolve quickly, and you'll often navigate multiple important initiatives at once.
We set high standards for this role to support our fast-paced growth.
Successful team members in this environment tend to:
Build trust through analytical rigor.
You present well-reasoned models and effectively articulate complex analysis to quantitative leaders.
Navigate fast-paced priorities with resilience.
You maintain focus, sound judgment, and positivity when balancing competing deadlines and feedback.
Offer constructive perspectives.
You confidently partner with senior stakeholders to propose data-backed alternative solutions and drive alignment to finalize decisions.
Embrace feedback as a growth tool.
You extract actionable insights from feedback and respond with clarity and openness.
Create order from ambiguity.
When there's no playbook, you build one, and you're comfortable acting on 80% of the information.
If you are excited by high standards, technical depth, and collaborative strategic discussions, you will find this work deeply rewarding.
The impact you will have
This is a hands-on, high-impact role.
Expected time on each area:
GTM compensation solutions and strategic advice (40%)
Work directly with GTM leaders to diagnose talent challenges such as competitive attrition, hard-to-fill roles, rapid scaling and reorganizations, and design attraction and retention solutions that fix them.
Turn vague or urgent requests into clear options with explicit tradeoffs, then help leaders reach a decision.
Serve as the main compensation advisor on strategic executive hires and high-stakes retention situations.
AI-enabled lifecycle compensation (30%)
Run merit, refresh equity and promotion cycles end to end for global GTM teams.
Design and build AI tools and workflows that reduce manual work and improve decisions.
Examples include offer modeling, retention-risk analysis, cycle quality checks, and self-serve insights for leaders.
Spot what's repetitive or error-prone in today's processes and automate it.
Enterprise compensation frameworks (30%)
Help scale Databricks' global compensation structure, including market pricing models, pay-for-performance design and equity strategy.
Build frameworks that solve today's problems and anticipate the ones coming as we grow.

Quantitative and technical skill is the foundation of this role.
Everything else we look for builds on it.
1.
Quantitative and technical foundation (required)
Expert-level analytical modeling.
You build compensation models from scratch, including cost-of-program scenarios, pay-positioning analysis, attrition and retention-risk modeling, and sensitivity and tradeoff analysis.
Built with AI.
You've personally used AI tools (for example LLMs, AI assistants, or automation and agent platforms) to build compensation tools, models or workflows that others rely on.

Statistical judgment.

Job architecture, compensation frameworks, market pricing, year-end and mid-year pay cycles, global compensation practices, and pay-for-performance design.

Deep knowledge of competitor compensation, especially new-hire and refresh equity strategy at high-growth and public tech companies.
You reason from first principles.
You balance compensation best practice with what the business actually needs, and you can rebuild a framework from its underlying logic when the standard approach doesn't fit.

Trusted advisor to senior leaders.
You have a track record of advising executives on sensitive, high-stakes compensation decisions (offers, promotions, leveling, retention, transfers, org changes) and influencing the outcome through data and judgment rather than authority.

You connect the dots between systems, stakeholders and programs to deliver compensation programs end to end, accurately and on time.

The Partner Enablement Operations Manager is a senior operator and builder responsible for designing and running a scalable, predictable, and data-driven operating model for partner enablement at Databricks.
This role serves as the operational backbone and strategic integrator for partner enablement, connecting global strategy to regional execution across AMER, EMEA, and APJ regions while ensuring programs are delivered consistently, efficiently, and at scale.

Own the partner enablement operating model, including core planning cadences, governance mechanisms, and execution frameworks that connect strategy to execution.

Build and maintain dashboards and operating reviews that surface partner engagement, program performance, risk signals, and areas requiring intervention.
Act as a key point of contact for cross-regional operational issues and escalations, resolving immediate friction while converting recurring issues into structural improvements.
Design and implement scalable workflows, SOPs, SLAs, and intake mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and create a better experience for internal stakeholders and partners.
Introduce AI-enabled and automation-first workflows for intake, reporting, support, certification, and partner operations where they can safely improve speed, quality, and scale.
Collaborate closely with the Partner organization, Learning and Enablement, Professional Services, and other cross-functional teams to remove friction and improve execution across the partner ecosystem.
Partner closely with the broader operations business to drive cross-functional leverage of ideas and excellence, ensuring new methods and operational innovations are scaled beyond just partner operations.
Establish clear ownership models, decision rights, and governance guardrails to support regional nuance without creating shadow processes or operational inconsistencies.
Architect and maintain automated intake management workflows and SLA tracking mechanisms to optimize request processing and eliminate wait-time bottlenecks.
Establish standardized metric definitions and executive reporting frameworks that pair activity and outcome indicators to ensure reporting integrity across cross-functional teams.
What You Bring
section_requirements:
10+ years of experience in Learning Operations, Program Management, Professional Services Operations, or a related operational leadership field in a high-growth technology environment.
Proven experience supporting global or multi-region teams and translating central strategy into executable operating plans.
Preferred experience in the Data & AI space, with a strong understanding of Databricks' platform capabilities, key differentiators, and end-to-end solutions, and the ability to work effectively with technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ownership of operating cadence, forecasting, planning, and execution frameworks in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn data into executive insight, operational decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience improving processes and workflows, with a clear track record of reducing manual effort and increasing scale through automation or AI-enabled solutions.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions without direct authority.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities across time zones, and drive execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment and lead strategic delivery across matrixed global organizations.
Experience designing and optimizing workflow automation, structured intake management, and operational reporting engines with strict metric definition discipline.

Deep expertise working with and for System Integrators (SIs) and ISVs, with a strong grasp of their core operational principles and business models.
Fluency with AI tools, workflow automation, and analytics platforms used to streamline operations and generate actionable insights.
Strong commercial and operational acumen, including comfort with utilization, forecasting, partner spend, margin thinking, or RevOps-aligned execution.
Experience operating in a highly matrixed international environment with sensitivity to regional and cultural nuance.

You will play a central role in shaping how partner enablement scales at Databricks.
This is a high-visibility role with meaningful impact, offering the opportunity to build a more efficient, governed, and AI-enabled operating model that helps our partner ecosystem grow with the business.
If you enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, building systems that remove friction, and helping teams scale through better operations rather than more manual work, this role is for you.

Operational Predictability: Build a disciplined partner enablement operating cadence where risks are surfaced early and execution is measurable and consistent.

section_about:
Databricks is at the forefront of data and AI innovation, and our Legal team plays a vital role in supporting this mission.
We are dedicated to navigating complex legal landscapes and ensuring compliance within the rapidly evolving technology sector.
Our team is composed of diverse legal professionals with expertise in technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate law, cybersecurity, employment law, tax, regulatory compliance, and litigation.
Databricks is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Counsel, Privacy to serve as a trusted advisor across the business.
In this role you will own and mature our privacy program, lead legal initiatives that deliver cutting-edge, practical legal advice as we navigate rapidly evolving global privacy and AI laws.
Reporting to the Director & Assistant General Counsel, Privacy, you will develop AI-enabled solutions for operating and maturing the privacy processes and controls that keep Databricks compliant.
You will be agile and highly organized, with the skills, drive, and flexibility to build and scale a program at a leading technology company, addressing cutting-edge legal issues and organizational challenges.
A successful candidate will be an AI proficient builder, resourceful self-starter, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, and excellent at building strong relationships and driving cross-functional execution.
The impact you will have
Legal advice and regulatory interpretation.
Advise on compliance with global privacy and data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, ADMT, and other U.S. state laws, Monitor legal and regulatory developments, and translate them into actionable guidance for the business.
Privacy Program & Governance Leadership: Build and mature Databricks' privacy program to continue meeting evolving regulatory expectations, including contributions to AI governance.
Develop core program components for compliance with new regulations, including data subject rights requests, privacy notices, consent management, PIA/DPIAs, and policy management.
Risk assessments.
Conduct gap analysis and risk assessments, including Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and transfer impact assessments to identify, assess, and help mitigate privacy risk, and support the organization's records of processing activities (RoPA).
Contract Negotiation and Transactions: Draft and update form agreements, and counsel on and negotiate data protection provisions in commercial contracts, including data processing addendums (DPAs), standard contractual clauses (SCCs), and related data-transfer instruments.
Policies, training, and governance.
Develop and maintain internal privacy policies, external privacy notices, and standards.
Design and deliver privacy training and awareness programs, and help operationalize privacy and AI governance frameworks and cross-functional privacy committees.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Legal Partnership: Build deep cross-functional relationships and collaborate with other legal leaders in commercial, go-to-market, compliance, corporate, and public affairs on privacy issues.
Business and Legal Judgment: Exercise practical judgment about when to approve, approve with conditions, decline, or escalate.
Team Contribution: Provide general legal support on a flexible, as-needed basis across other areas of the business, and contribute as a team player to further the legal department's reputation as an effective, respected, and valued resource within the company.
What we look for
7+ years of relevant legal experience at a top law firm and/or in-house (a combination of both is a plus), with 5+ years focused on privacy and demonstrated experience building, operating, or leading a privacy compliance program (not solely advisory work)
Deep, current knowledge of global privacy and AI frameworks, including the GDPR/UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, EU AI Act, and the growing patchwork of U.S. state comprehensive privacy and AI laws, and familiarity with cross-border data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, IDTA, adequacy, EU-U.S.
Data Privacy Framework).
Working knowledge of the operational building blocks of a privacy program - DPIAs/PIAs, ROPA and data mapping, data subject rights processes, privacy by design, and vendor/third-party risk management
Technical proficiency in using AI tools to build skills, agents, and other automated tasks.
Capacity to be a generalist and learn new areas of law and legal skills quickly as the business evolves
Deep understanding of cloud and software technology, and a strong desire to work on legal issues in these areas
Experience working for a company offering platform services to business customers is a plus
Familiarity with privacy management tooling (e.g., OneTrust or comparable) is a plus
J.D. from a top-tier law school
State bar membership required, in good standing
One or more privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, CIPT, FIP) preferred; CIPM is particularly valued for a program-leadership role
What you bring
You can set the direction for a program and drive it into execution - prioritizing and managing time and client expectations amid competing demands, often without direct guidance, as we scale our rapidly expanding business.
You exercise good judgment in raising issues, assessing risk, and providing concise, actionable, business-focused legal advice and counsel.
You build strong, deep working relationships with internal stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions, and are comfortable working with distributed teams.
You are a self-starter who operates independently and interacts confidently with senior management, influencing without authority.
You have a strong work ethic, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage many cross-functional projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.
You have outstanding written and verbal communication skills and can make complex privacy and regulatory concepts clear to both legal and non-legal audiences, including executives.

You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules.
Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale.

GAQ126R44
About Databricks
At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems-and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products.
The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company.
For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows.
We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.
We're looking for a SAP Developer to build the applications, extensions, and integrations that bring this vision to life.
In this role, you'll write clean-core extensions on SAP BTP, build full-stack apps and Fiori experiences, wire up integrations between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, and help embed AI and agentic capabilities directly into finance workflows.
You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI-shipping software that makes finance operations faster, smarter, and more automated.
The Opportunity
SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash.
As an SAP Developer, you'll be hands-on-keyboard building the layer that makes those processes intelligent: side-by-side extensions on BTP, event-driven integrations into the Lakehouse, and AI-assisted workflows that automate routine work and guide users through exceptions and approvals.
You'll build with modern SAP and Databricks AI tooling-combining SAP's core ERP capabilities with Databricks-native AI, agentic applications, and automation-while keeping the SAP digital core clean, scalable, and upgradable.
Your mission is to turn designs into robust, production-grade software that combines the strength of SAP with the power of Databricks AI.
section_responsibilities:
Build Clean-Core Extensions: Develop in-app and side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP that keep the S/4HANA digital core clean and upgrade-ready, using released APIs and extension points rather than core modifications.
Develop Databricks-Native Applications: Build scalable, full-stack applications and services on the Databricks platform that extend and integrate with SAP, leveraging Databricks-native capabilities, APIs, data services, and AI/agentic tooling to deliver modern Finance experiences while keeping the SAP core clean.
Build Integrations: Implement secure, resilient integrations across SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP Integration Suite, event-driven patterns, APIs, OData v4, and change-data feeds into the Databricks Lakehouse, with solid error handling and monitoring.
Embed AI & Agentic Capabilities: Build AI-powered and agentic capabilities into Finance workflows using Databricks AI, integrating seamlessly with SAP and other enterprise systems.
Apply RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, and human-in-the-loop controls to automate processes safely while maintaining governance and auditability
Move SAP Data to the Lakehouse: Partner with data engineering to build the pipelines and extraction patterns (CDC, OData, APIs) that land SAP data in Databricks cleanly, with attention to modeling, lineage, and data quality.
Engineer for Quality: Write unit and integration tests, work within CI/CD and transport pipelines for ABAP and BTP artifacts, participate in code reviews, and follow the team's security and coding standards.
Collaborate: Work closely with the technical lead, functional experts, and product owners to turn requirements and designs into working software, and iterate quickly based on user feedback.
What You Bring
6+ years of SAP development experience, with hands-on delivery of at least one end-to-end SAP solution (an S/4HANA extension, a CAP or RAP app on BTP with Fiori, or an Integration Suite flow) in production.
Modern ABAP: Strong command of ABAP Cloud, ABAP CDS, and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), plus OData (v2/v4).
SAP BTP: Working-to-advanced experience with BTP runtimes, core services (Connectivity, Destination, XSUAA/auth), and deploying, securing, and operating apps on the platform.
Front End: Solid experience with SAP Fiori concepts, SAPUI5, and Fiori Elements (OData v4).
Integration: Experience with SAP Integration Suite / API Management and event-driven patterns (OData/REST, IDoc, Cloud Integration, Event Mesh) across hybrid landscapes.
AI Fluency: Strong understanding of SAP and Databricks AI capabilities, with practical knowledge of generative AI and agentic concepts-including RAG, prompt engineering, grounding, tool calling, and enterprise AI governance.
Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications and workflows on Databricks and integrating them with SAP is a strong plus.
Engineering Practice: Comfort with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern dev tooling (VS Code, ABAP Development Tools in Eclipse, MTA/CF packaging).
Clean-Core Mindset: Understanding of clean-core principles and why extensions belong side-by-side or in-app rather than in the digital core.
Collaboration: Clear communicator who can work across functional, product, and engineering teams and take ownership of what they ship.

Domain knowledge in finance, procurement, or supply chain that speeds delivery and requirements understanding.
Experience extending or customizing Joule agents via SAP Build / Joule Studio, or building agents on SAP AI Foundation.
Experience building applications on modern data platforms (such as Databricks) that extend or sit alongside SAP.
Cloud-native experience-containerization and Kubernetes (Kyma), observability, and scalability patterns.
SAP certification in ABAP, SAP BTP, or SAP Build, and prior work in a high-growth technology company.

section_intro:
CSQ427R106
At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey.
You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers.
You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability for our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage of Databricks workloads they have already selected, helping them maximize the value they get from our platform and their return on investment.
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role.
It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon.
This is in parallel to being technical, with the expectation that you will become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products.
This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate effectively with an organization at all levels.
You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.
The impact you will have:
Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to the production/go-live status of agreed-upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical experts, to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create, own, and execute a point of view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews, and upgrade needs
Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the following work streams:
Main use cases moving from 'win' to production
Enablement/user growth plan
Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks' Lakehouse vision)
Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
Executive and operational governance
Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM
What we look for:
5+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project/program delivery within the domain of Data and AI, and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
Programming experience in Python, SQL, or Scala
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
Understanding of solution architecture related to distributed data systems
Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
Technical program, or project management, including account, stakeholder, and resource management accountability
Experience in resolving complex and important escalations with senior customer executives
Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis, and managing the delivery of complex programs/projects
Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
Ability to travel up to 30% when needed
Pay Range Transparency
Local Pay Range
$180,000-$247,500 USD

job_title: Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE - Manufacturing & High-Tech
section_intro: CSQ327R212
section_about:
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored by the CEO and Founders.
Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call through to a production-ready solution.
You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
Role description:
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution.
You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value.
You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing.
You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
The impact you will have:
C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester.
Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues.
Lead technical discovery and design reviews.
Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value.
Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations.
Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement.
Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.
What we look for:
Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills.
You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns.
You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language, such as Python, Java, or SQL.
You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder.
You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments.
Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable.
You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

section_intro:
GAQ226R76
About Databricks
At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems-and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products.
The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company.
For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows.
We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.
We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them.
In this role, you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain-translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process.
You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience.
The Opportunity
SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash.
As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes-leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals.
You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules.
Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale.
section_responsibilities:
Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible.
Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short.
Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements.
Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements-task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants-and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer.
Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI.
Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features.
Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements-cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption-and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives.
Enable Adoption: Coach and upskill process owners and functional teams on process intelligence, best practices, and AI adoption, and drive readiness and change management for what you ship.
What You Bring
6+ years of SAP functional consulting experience, with hands-on delivery across at least one full S/4HANA lifecycle and deep expertise in one or more finance domains-Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash-plus working fluency in adjacent areas and in master-data governance.
Process Intelligence: Demonstrated experience leading process discovery, process mapping, and process mining using SAP Process Intelligence or equivalent BPI tools, and translating mining outputs into solution requirements.
Clean-Core Mindset: Strong bias toward standard, clean-core S/4HANA design, with sound judgment about when a requirement genuinely warrants an extension versus a change in process.
AI & Agentic Automation: Practical experience applying Databricks AI and agentic capabilities to enterprise processes, with strong judgment on where AI can drive automation and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance, controls, auditability, and human oversight.
Integration Awareness: Solid understanding of integration patterns (APIs/OData, IDoc, SAP Integration Suite / BTP) and the data requirements that feed process mining and AI models.
Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to design processes and automation that satisfy them.
Stakeholder Leadership: Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, and the ability to present executive-level ROI and translate technical capability into measurable business value.
Business-First Mindset: Pragmatic, outcome-driven approach to reducing process waste and risk, and comfort leading through ambiguity across complex business and IT landscapes.

Familiarity with the SAP AI and extension stack (BTP, AI Core, Joule) and a point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs against a Databricks-native approach.
Experience working alongside data teams to make ERP data usable for analytics and AI on modern data platforms (such as Databricks), and prior work in a high-growth technology company where ERP had to scale quickly.

Accounting Data & Technology Manager
section_about:
We are building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands.
We are seeking an Accounting Data & Technology Manager to join our Global Accounting team and serve as the architect of the redesign of our accounting processes by building automation solutions and managing data pipelines that power our global accounting organization.
You will serve as the accounting team's S/4HANA expert - the person who ensures our in-flight SAP implementation reflects best practice rather than a lift-and-shift of how we operate in NetSuite today.
You will be responsible for bridging the gap between our team's subject matter experts, our technology solutions, and the business data needed to support accounting operations.
In addition to SAP ownership, this role will build purposeful, reliable solutions on top of the Databricks platform and Finance Datalake to accelerate global accounting operations.
During the SAP implementation, you will work alongside our system integrator to challenge design decisions, identify where SAP's native capabilities can replace manual workarounds, and ensure the accounting team is building on the right foundation from day one.
Post go-live, the role transitions to continuous improvement - owning automation opportunities, streamlining close processes as SAP capabilities evolve, and ensuring Databricks is getting progressively more value out of the platform over time rather than running it as a static system.
This is a rare opportunity to shape a major ERP platform from day one at one of the world's fastest-growing technology companies, with the autonomy to define how SAP works for accounting at Databricks - and how it connects to the most advanced data and AI platform in the market.
section_responsibilities:
SAP Implementation Governance (Near-Term)
Work alongside our system integrator as the accounting team's internal SAP S/4HANA subject matter expert throughout the implementation program.
Challenge design decisions and configuration choices - ensuring they reflect SAP best practice rather than replicating current-state NetSuite processes.
Identify where SAP's native capabilities (standard workflows, automated postings, embedded analytics, Fiori apps) can replace manual workarounds and custom development.
Own the accounting team's requirements, testing, and sign-off for SAP configuration across core FICO areas - general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and close management.
Partner with our system integrator, IT and Finance Transformation to ensure data migration, chart of accounts design, and master data governance meet accounting's needs.
Continuous Improvement & Optimization (Post Go-Live)
Own the SAP continuous improvement roadmap for accounting - identifying automation opportunities, process simplifications, and new SAP capabilities as they are released.
Streamline close processes within SAP - driving adoption of native automation, reducing cycle time, eliminating manual steps, and improving data quality with each close cycle.
Monitor system performance and proactively address configuration issues, data quality gaps, and process bottlenecks.
Collaborate with Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Accounts Payable, Revenue, and Procurement to ensure SAP configuration supports end-to-end finance processes - not just accounting in isolation.
Ensure SOX-relevant system controls (automated, access and change management controls) within SAP are properly configured, documented, and operating effectively.
SAP × Databricks Platform Integration
Own the design and governance of how SAP accounting data flows into the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform - ensuring clean, timely, and well-structured data for financial reporting, analytics, and AI use cases.
Partner with Data Engineering and Finance Systems to define the SAP-to-Databricks integration architecture - including extraction patterns, data models, and refresh cadences that support close timelines and ad-hoc analysis.
Identify opportunities to leverage Databricks' AI and automation capabilities on top of SAP data - such as anomaly detection on journal entries, predictive accruals, automated reconciliation matching, and natural-language reporting via Genie.
Serve as the accounting team's voice in shaping how Databricks' own platform is used for internal finance operations - ensuring the company is a best-practice reference customer for its own technology.
What We're Looking For

Experience supporting external audits and SOX compliance in a consolidation context.
Proven experience partnering with remote teams across different geographic areas, including with US-based accounting leadership, and the flexibility to support close timelines that span US Pacific Time hours.

section_intro:
At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems.
Our customers leverage the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to power their mission critical Data and AI applications to improve how their organisations leverage data and insights to make better decisions, faster.
Customers rely on Databricks for the full range of data workloads, including data engineering, ETL, near real-time streaming, machine learning, SQL analytics, and advanced analytics.
The Solutions Architect (EDW Migrations) executes on Databricks' strategic product lines to develop, establish and drive product adoption and product market fit to grow customer adoption across EMEA.
By working with leadership, product and direct account teams, you will jointly engage customers, foster the necessary relationships and position in-depth approaches to migrating their EDW to the Databricks Intelligence Platform.
You will develop the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed for customers to successfully deliver on their business objectives.
The Solutions Architect (EDW Migrations) is paired with Product Specialists for Data and Governance.
Together, you will devise and implement a strategy across key accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets, and with account teams deliver them such that the field and customers make informed decisions on adoption strategy and its implementation.
The impact you will have
Lead Regional Migration Strategy: Collaborate with EMEA GTM leadership and account teams to design and drive the technical GTM and adoption strategy for large-scale EDW migrations to the Databricks Intelligence Platform
Develop Programmatic and Scalable Migration Processes: Architect and continuously refine programmatic assets and detailed technical guides that enable field teams and partners to execute migrations.
Build and Integrate Assessment Tooling: Help maintain, enhance, and direct the development of automated assessment tools from customer engagements.
Drive Tier-3 Technical Championship: Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for highly complex, strategic, or stalled migrations in must-win accounts across EMEA.
Enable and Scale the Regional teams: Scale the presales migration practice by mentoring and coaching the EMEA community of Solutions Architects (SAs) and Specialist SAs (SSAs) to ensure scale.
Bridge Field Insights and Product R&D: Serve as a primary technical feedback loop to Product Management and Engineering.
Establish Industry Thought Leadership: Author whitepapers, publish technical blogs, and deliver high-impact presentations at public forums (such as the Data + AI Summit) to position the Databricks Intelligence Platform as the premier platform for enterprise database modernization.
Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.
Competencies & Responsibilities
8+ Years of Customer-Facing Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, architect, or consulting role influencing technical executives (CIOs, CISOs, DBAs, and Platform Leads) and driving high-level database modernization strategy.
Legacy Data Warehouse & Modernization Architecture understanding of legacy EDW systems (any of Teradata, Netezza, Snowflake, Synapse, Redshift, and Exadata) and architectures required to successfully transition workloads to the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
Mastery of migration migrations scope & progression taking customers from EDW to the full capabilities of the Data Intelligence Platform.
Demonstrated competence in the Lakehouse architecture including hands-on experience with Apache Spark, Python and SQL
Excellent communication skills; both written and verbal
Public Cloud Architecting: Hands-on experience designing and implementing big data architectures within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Strategic Enablement & Community Mentorship
Experience collaborating with Professional Services and Global Systems Integrators to standardize migration delivery methodologies and ensure smooth handoffs.

Mission
Databricks is seeking a Manager, Marketing Insights Business Partner to serve as the embedded insights partner to the [VP/GM] of EMEA Marketing and their leadership team.
This role exists to create leverage: to make marketing performance easier to understand, easier to act on, and easier to improve.
Reporting to the Director, Marketing Insights, you will bring analytical rigor and a clear point of view to how EMEA plans, forecasts, measures, and improves its work.
Beyond reporting on outcomes, you will produce the forecast leadership plans against, hold visibility into how the work itself is running, and help scope and land the pilots that change how we operate.
You will partner closely with Marketing Leadership, Campaign Operations, Marketing Platform & Systems, Sales Operations and Finance.
The impact you will have:
Serve as the insights partner to the [VP/GM] of EMEA Marketing and their leadership team, delivering the analysis and narrative required for business reviews, QBRs, and pipeline councils, so that leadership forums produce actionable decisions.
Maintain a single, trusted view of EMEA marketing performance across a consistent framework of marketing motions, standardizing dashboards and reporting inputs so teams work from a consistent read on what is working, what is not, and where risk is emerging.
Support functional target-setting model for EMEA, including program, channel, and product-level contribution, and produce the forecast leadership plans that other teams can rely on.
Maintain the leading-indicator framework for EMEA, identifying the early signals that predict outcome performance, so that intervention happens while the quarter can still change, rather than being diagnosed after it closes.
Translate performance data into insight, implications, and recommended areas of focus tied to internal milestones and supporting cross-functional requirements within regions.
Own execution telemetry for EMEA, maintaining visibility into how marketing work is actually running through cycle times, throughput, intake, and SLA performance to reduce operational friction.
Increase the region's self-sufficiency in accessing and using performance data by driving practical, repeatable adoption of Genie and reducing dependency on central data teams for routine reporting and analysis.
Support pilot execution, defining the hypothesis, success criteria, and measurement approach before launch, and delivering a clear read at the end.
Surface and codify what is already working in one market or motion so that proven approaches can be picked up elsewhere, and instrument them so the gain stays visible after the initial push.
Support the planning cycle with the analytical & programmatic inputs that make investment decisions defensible, including historical performance, efficiency by motion, and target-setting inputs.
Identify analytical and data risks early, including data quality issues, reporting gaps, and system performance outages, so they are surfaced and addressed before they escalate.
Act as the region's voice in the global Marketing Insights function, surfacing regional requirements and gaps so that global frameworks and tooling work in-region rather than requiring local workarounds.

This Manager role within Databricks' Credit & Collections organisation is responsible for driving credit strategy, strategic customer collections, AR performance, and complex escalations across a high-growth, usage-based Data/AI business.
The role combines financial and commercial judgment with hands-on customer engagement, functional oversight of collection operations, and governance of the outsourced collections model.
This is a high-impact opportunity for a CA, CPA, or experienced finance professional to take ownership of credit risk, cash, strategic customer relationships, and AR performance at Databricks scale.
This is an individual contributor position with an expectation to be hands-on.

Lead the Credit & Collections function for an assigned scope within Databricks, including credit policies, collection practices, risk mitigation, and escalation protocols
Own credit assessment, risk reviews, credit limits, payment terms, credit holds/releases, and exception management within the established approval framework
Make credit recommendations and decisions within delegated authority, balancing credit risk, cash conversion, and commercial considerations
Personally manage collections strategy and executive-level escalations for strategic and high-value Databricks customers
Lead resolution of complex disputes, contractual payment issues, and commercially sensitive collection matters

Translate AR and credit trends into actionable insights for Finance leadership, including emerging risks, recovery outlook, and bad debt/reserve considerations
Manage the Accenture collections engagement, including SLA/KPI governance, account allocation, quality, process adherence, escalations, and corrective actions
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, Legal, Billing, and Finance leadership to resolve high-impact credit and collection matters
Identify systemic drivers of delinquency and credit exposure and lead initiatives to strengthen controls, processes, and collection effectiveness
Drive process transformation and continuous improvement across Credit & Collections, leveraging automation, AI, analytics, and scalable operating models to improve efficiency and decision-making
Serve as the subject-matter authority for Credit & Collections, providing guidance on complex cases, policies, credit decisions, and commercial considerations
What we look for:
Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting is a must; CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
12+ years of progressive experience across Credit & Collections, ideally within high-growth SaaS, technology, or complex B2B environments
Proven experience in credit risk assessment, collections strategy, and managing strategic or high-value customer relationships
Strong understanding of usage-based and subscription billing models, commercial contracts, and associated credit risks
Demonstrated experience owning AR KPIs, collection targets, CEI, DSO, ageing, cash forecasting, write-offs, and bad debt/reserve analysis
Experience operationalising credit policies, approval frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies
Experience governing outsourced collections operations against defined SLAs and performance metrics
Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate large datasets into clear financial and risk insights
Advanced Excel and strong ERP/reporting systems experience; SAP, NetSuite and Salesforce preferred
Demonstrated experience driving process transformation, automation, or technology-enabled improvements; practical application of AI in finance or AR operations is a plus
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with customers and senior cross-functional stakeholders
This role will require working in PST hours.

You will collaborate with payroll vendors, internal partners, and employees to deliver compliant, efficient payroll operations.

This role reports to the Payroll Director based in UK.

Payroll processing support - Partner with the Payroll Analyst team in India to prepare, validate, and reconcile payroll data for the countries specified above or as per org design, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.

System proficiency - Experience with Workday Payroll or a similar HRIS/payroll system, with the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly.
Analytical & technical skills - Intermediate Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs, formulas) and the ability to analyse and reconcile payroll data for accuracy.

Collaboration & communication - Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners in HR, Finance, and external vendors.

This position is perfect for someone who:
Thrives in a collaborative environment, working closely with other payroll colleagues while contributing to accurate and timely payrolls across multiple countries.
Enjoys solving payroll challenges and ensuring compliance with local regulations.
Wants exposure to multi-country payroll complexities and the opportunity to strengthen Asia payroll expertise.
Values process improvement and the chance to contribute ideas that make payroll operations more efficient.
Appreciates working in a high-growth company where there's room to learn, develop, and take on new responsibilities over time.

Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the data lifecycle with a unified Lakehouse platform for data engineering, analytics, and AI.

Learn more about the Lakehouse architecture.
Lakeflow is a critical part of this vision, helping customers build and operate streaming and batch ETL pipelines that power business-critical data products.
As these workloads become increasingly mission-critical, customers need them to continue operating through infrastructure failures and cloud-region outages.
As a Staff Engineer on the part of the Lakeflow Disaster Recovery team, you will design and implement distributed systems that replicate and recover pipelines across regions.
A pipeline is more than source code and output tables: it includes streaming checkpoints, source offsets, stateful operator state, table versions, transaction metadata, schedules, and dependencies across a dataflow graph.
You will solve challenging problems involving consistency, idempotency, causal ordering, failover, failback, and safe recovery without silent data loss or duplication.

Cross-region replication and recovery for Lakeflow pipelines, streaming tables, and materialized views
Distributed consistency across pipeline dependencies, table versions, and transaction logs
Failover and failback workflows with conservative correctness guardrails
Deep clone, metadata reconciliation, observability, and failure-injection testing
High-fidelity recovery simulations, game-day testing, and formal reasoning about failure modes
What we look for:
A passion for distributed systems, databases, storage systems, streaming systems, or reliability engineering
Strong software engineering skills in Java, Scala, C++, Go, Python, or a similar production language
Understanding of consistency, transactions, idempotency, replication, checkpointing, and data lineage
Ability to define and work toward a multi-year technical vision with incremental, production-quality deliverables

section_intro:
RDQ427R198
The Opportunity
Multi-cloud is core to Databricks product strategy.
Compute serves as the layer that abstracts the cloud from the rest of the company.
Building unified infrastructure on top of heterogeneous clouds is a challenge that few companies experience.
As an engineer on this team, you won't just manage infrastructure; you will build it as a product.
You will tackle the hard problems of distributed systems: sub-second container/MicroVM startup times, multi-tenant security isolation, and building a unified orchestration layer that scales across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
section_responsibilities:
Design and build the next generation of our Serverless platform, focusing on high availability, low latency, and scale-to-zero efficiency.
Build a single compute stack that supports heterogeneous workloads, including GPU instance qualification for AI training and stateful execution for Lakebase.
Solve Multi-Cloud Complexity: Develop platform-level abstractions that allow Databricks to run seamlessly across all major cloud providers.
Optimize everything from the API gateway down to the host-level networking and container orchestration.
Work alongside industry experts who have built world-class systems like Borg, Kubernetes, and Uber's infrastructure.
What We're Looking For
5+ years of production-level experience in one of: Python, Java, Scala, C++, or a similar language
4+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems from scratch
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or MicroVM technologies (e.g., Firecracker) and a strong grasp of cloud provider internals (AWS/Azure/GCP).
You aren't just a user of tools; you understand how to build them from the ground up when existing solutions fail at our scale.

Partner Solutions Architect specializing in Customer Lake and Lakewatch, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for accelerating platform adoption and scaling growth across our strategic partner ecosystem (SIs, GSIs, ISVs, and Cloud Providers).
You serve as the definitive technical authority and trusted advisor for partner technical practices, empowering them to architect, position, and deploy enterprise solutions built on our Customer Lake platform, while leveraging Lakewatch for data quality and system monitoring.

Advise Partner Leadership: Act as a trusted technical advisor to partner CTOs, Chief Architects, and Practice Leads, aligning their technology roadmaps with Customer Lake and Lakewatch innovations
Build Reusable Blueprints: Develop enablement kits, reference architectures, and deployment blueprints that simplify partner integration and rollout
Orchestrate Cross-Functional Teams: Collaborate across internal Field Engineering, Product, and Partner Management teams to deliver unified partner GTM initiatives

8+ years in solutions architecture, partner technical management, principal engineering, or senior customer-/partner-facing technical pre-sales roles

section_intro:
Deeply understanding what's in the enterprise data has been a challenge that Databricks has been addressing by providing analytics and machine learning tools.
From data warehousing with Databricks SQL to large-scale distributed processing with Spark and advanced ML tools for experimentation and model serving, we empower our customers to gain insights and drive innovation.
To enable all of this on Databricks, making data ingestion seamless is crucial.
That's the mission of the Ingestion Core Team: to make the ingestion of all data-structured and unstructured-simple, reliable, and efficient.
Simplifying the complex is hard, and that's where you come in.
This role requires building distributed platform systems to incrementally ingest high-volume, petabyte-scale data from diverse sources-including cloud storage (SQS, ADLS, GCS), databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Postgres), and file sources (Google Drive, SharePoint)-at high throughput and low cost.
The data includes structured formats (JSON, Parquet, CSV) as well as unstructured data (text, images, docs, PPTs, and blobs), all of which land in Delta Lake with schema evolution and change data capture (CDC) capabilities.
Join us in making data ingestion effortless and be part of the team that powers the future of AI + data at Databricks!
As an engineer on the team, you will work on projects that:
Build distributed infrastructure to ingest data from diverse sources and support streaming ingestion, incremental processing, and replication.
This isn't just about building plugin connectors.
Reduce end-to-end latency, increase throughput, and reduce costs from the time data appears in source systems to when it is available in Delta Lake.
Design and optimize streaming and distributed workloads for throughput, cost, latency, reliability, and scale.
Optimize streaming workloads by exploring and applying ML techniques.
Build monitoring and observability capabilities (customer-facing and internal) that provide visibility into ingestion workflows and the systems running them.
Collaborate with partner teams to enable use cases like RAG and AI agents.

Experience with distributed systems, streaming, Spark, databases, data processing, or CDC.

Connect core security infrastructure to platform services so unified identity, data lineage, and audit controls extend across structured, unstructured, and AI workloads.
Resolve cross-organizational blockers with Director-, VP-, and C-suite engineering leaders while balancing technical tradeoffs and resource constraints.
