section_about:
Databricks needs to understand what technical capability looks like across several large, fast-moving populations: employees, customers, and partners.
Today that happens through role-based learning pathways and product-aligned enablement, an approach that can't keep pace with how quickly the platform, technology, and roles change.
AI has also collapsed the half-life of technical proficiency, and for the first time, it makes a living, self-maintaining model of capability possible.
In this builder role, you'll own systems for defining, measuring, and developing technical capability across Databricks learner audiences.
You'll build a capability model that ties roles, skills, content, and credentials together and the instrumentation that shows where capability actually stands.
What You'll Own
Skills taxonomies, capability models, and learning context
Define the skills taxonomies that make up technical capability and shape how they're organized; what skills exist, which are adjacent, which are prerequisites, how quickly they go stale, and what sources are available to learners for developing and maintaining them.
Observability and measurement
Stand up instrumentation and AI-informed signals that show where capability stands and where it's drifting.
Develop live signals, not a quarterly or monthly health index, to show how skills are moving and evolving.
Anticipate where capability demand is heading.
Product releases, market shifts, and role evolution are constant; track changes closely so emerging skills surface early and content and programs stay ahead of change.
AI-native tooling
Build the software that maintains the skills taxonomy and capability model, including LLM-driven skill extraction and organization, agentic pipelines that keep them current, automated drift and gap detection, and APIs that expose it all.
Make the model reusable enterprise context that other systems, teams, and products build on vs. a training-only asset.
Impact You'll Have
You will sit upstream of and across several teams and functions:
Anywhere skills show up in products: You define what technical capability means and what evidence counts, so wherever skills are inferred, captured, or recognized, it reflects real technical work and skills & abilities.
Content and curriculum.
The skills taxonomy and capability model influence what gets built next and why.
Learning context is a critical input to generative content.
Learning architecture and in-product training: Your work informs what learning belongs where and how it's presented.
Pathways are assembled with the model and taxonomy instead of mapped by hand; in-product training surfaces them to learners.
Certification & accreditation.
The capability model grounds skills assessment to guide and accelerate exam developers.
Learning & enablement.
You give the organization a current view of capability across every audience, and a shared model to build and plan against.
What We're Looking For
Experience in technical training, learning, enablement, or product education in data & AI, cloud, or comparable product categories.
Experience designing capability or skills models and the systems around them, spanning modeling, measurement, and instrumentation.
A builder mindset.
Ability to use Python and SQL and build apps, with AI assistance, and wire up pipelines and stand up tooling yourself.
AI-native.
AI tooling is how you build and reason, from extraction and assessment to agentic workflows and evaluation.
You understand when to reach for AI and when not.
A track record of moving strategy as an IC through analysis and clear writing.
section_preferred:
Familiarity with off-the-shelf skills-intelligence tooling and build-vs-buy tradeoffs.
Experience instrumenting capability data across several audiences.
What Success Looks Like in Year One
A live skills taxonomy, capability model, and learning context resources are published, and content, learning, and certification teams plan against them.
Decisions about what to build, refresh, or retire leverage the skills taxonomy and capability model, so content better keeps pace with the product, and investment goes where capability demand and skill gaps are real.
In-product training uses the model to target and measure learning, so learners can see what moves them forward, and stakeholders get insight into skills attainment within their audiences.
Teams that bring skills into products work from the same model, so a skill means the same thing wherever someone encounters it.

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you are a trusted technical advisor to key customers, providing expert guidance that translates data, analytics and AI challenges into high-impact business value.
You help design, implement, and scale data and AI solutions, focusing on architecture, operational excellence, and customer enablement.
Internally, you will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks Platform in your customers.
Delivery Solutions Architects (DSAs) are trusted technical advisors embedded within the customer organization, providing expert guidance that translates data and AI challenges into high-impact business value.
They help you design, implement, and scale data and AI solutions, focusing on architecture, operational excellence, and team enablement.
DSAs focus on:
Designing secure, scalable architecture
Aligning people, processes, and technology
Establishing trusted advisor relationships
Leveraging the broader ecosystem of Databricks experts
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role.
Technically, the expectations are that you become the post-sales technical lead and trusted advisor across all Databricks products for the customer's top priority use cases.
This requires you to use your technical skills and credibility to engage and communicate with technical/technical leadership stakeholders in our customer organizations, do architecture reviews, help with performance and cost optimizations, demonstrate new capabilities, remove blockers, etc.
In parallel, it is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving onboarding plans.
While not a hands-on-keyboard role, this is a highly technical position where architectural skills in fields such as Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Warehousing or Data Science are essential.
You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.
The impact you will have:
Be the Databricks Architect working with customer technical teams working on use cases/data products, from development to go-live, addressing any technical challenges and blockers and providing guidance, best practices and enablement
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts

Programming experience in PySpark, Python and Databricks (or similar data platform)

Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer technical stakeholders

As the Director of Technical Marketing at Databricks, you will lead and scale the team responsible for explaining Databricks products, and what you can do with them, at scale to technical buyers and practitioners (from data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to solutions architects, platform teams, security engineers, and application developers).
You will own the strategy and execution of technical content in written and video form, demos, workshops, launch storytelling, and outbound evangelism that drives technical mindshare, consideration, product adoption, and ultimately pipeline.
In the era of agentic marketing and AEO/GEO, your team will increasingly produce content designed to educate both humans and agents alike.
You will also play an outsized role in programming the technical content for key Databricks events, such as the Data + AI Summit and Data + AI World Tour, among others.
Reporting to the SVP of Product & Solutions Marketing, you will manage a team of 6+ Technical Marketing Managers (growing) and serve as the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and the broader technical community.
This role expands the traditional TMM charter to include a stronger outbound evangelism dimension, becoming a visible, trusted technical voice externally through social media, YouTube, conferences, and the data practitioner ecosystem while continuing to own the core technical content engine that powers Summit, World Tour, workshops, and field enablement.
The impact you will have:
First 6 months:
Assess the current TMM team's strengths, gaps, and capacity; establish a clear operating model with defined ownership areas (product coverage, content types, GEO) and a quarterly planning cadence.
Own and deliver the technical content agenda for Data + AI World Tour and/or the next major Tier 1 event, achieving ≥4.5/5.0 average session ratings and measurable pipeline contribution.
Launch or significantly expand at least 2 new outbound evangelism motions (e.g., a YouTube series architecture, a technical social media cadence, or a creator/influencer engagement program) that grow Databricks' external technical reach by ≥25%.
Build an AI-powered publishing engine that enables the TMM team to scale content faster, leveraging AI assistance for content creation and publishing.
Establish yourself as a credible external technical voice, publishing 3+ original technical pieces (blogs, videos, or talks) and representing Databricks at 2+ external events or podcasts.
First 12 months:
Scale the TMM team to meet growing demand across an expanding set of technical personas (solutions architects, platform engineers, security teams, data scientists, analysts, app developers) driven by the 2026+ product surface (Lakebase, Genie, Lakewatch, Agent Bricks, Omnigent).
Work with Databricks Field Engineering and FDE (Forward-Deployed Engineering) to capture repeatable product use cases into a Solutions Library, building a motion to scale capture and marketing of these use cases for learning across the entire community.
Build and operationalize a "1 launch → many assets" content engine that converts every major product launch into persona-specific learning journeys (demos, workshops, blogs, videos, social).
Grow Databricks' YouTube and social technical content reach by 2x, with a series-based content architecture targeting key personas at multiple depth levels.
Drive measurable contribution to AEO/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ensuring Databricks is cited by default in AI answer engines for key buyer questions.
First 18-24 months:
Establish Databricks as the default place every technical practitioner learns data + AI, measured by YouTube subscriber growth (target: 300K+), technical content engagement, and Free Edition activation rates tied to content.
Build a formal Databricks Creators program that turns independent creator reach into co-owned, accurate, early-access content across new product areas.
Develop the TMM team into a recognized center of excellence - with clear career paths, a strong hiring bar, and a reputation as one of the best technical marketing teams in enterprise software.
What we look for:
10+ years of experience in technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, field engineering, or a related technical field in enterprise software / SaaS / cloud.
3+ years of people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams.
Deep technical fluency in data, AI/ML, and cloud platforms, comfortable building demos and engaging credibly with data engineers, data scientists, solutions architects, and other technical practitioners across the data + AI ecosystem.
Demonstrated outbound evangelism skills, including a visible external presence through conference speaking, technical blogging, YouTube/video content, or social media thought leadership.
Experience owning technical content strategy for major product launches and flagship events (e.g., user conferences, world tours).
Strong cross-functional influence with a proven ability to partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and Sales to align on priorities and deliver integrated GTM.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for multiple audiences.
Preferred:
Experience with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, Apache Spark, or related open-source data technologies.
Experience building or scaling a YouTube channel, podcast, or technical content program for practitioner audiences.
Familiarity with GEO / AI answer engine optimization strategies.
Experience with technical community building, creator programs, or influencer engagement across practitioner audiences.
Track record of building technical content that drives measurable pipeline and product adoption.

Most strong candidates have two of these, and some have three.
We are hiring for trajectory: you should already be strong in the operating and the building, and hungry to grow into relationships and strategy.
This is one of the rare seats where operating, building, and relationship-building are the same job.

Run the startup program: Own the day-to-day operations of the program, including applicant intake, evaluation, scoring, routing, and offer decisions, with precise tracking of every applicant, commitment, and outcome.

Assess and translate: Assess each founder's technical capability and the strength of their idea, and carry what you learn back to Product and to Databricks Ventures.
Run founder and investor events: Design and run a regular calendar of founder and investor gatherings in San Francisco, including dinners, workshops, office hours, and demo-day tie-ins.

Genuinely technical with AI.
You build.

section_about:
We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit - one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA.
Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.
You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.
This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI.
You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.
section_responsibilities:
Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.
Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases - from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.
Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.
Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.
Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering - channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.
Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.
Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader - conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.
What We're Looking For
Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.
Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.
Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).
Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.
Experience with the Databricks platform - or the ability to ramp on it quickly - including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog.
Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.
A track record of technical leadership and mentorship - someone who elevates the people around them.
Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.
Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.
Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.
section_preferred:
Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.
Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.
Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.
Why This Role
You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have - companies building the future in real time - with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise.
You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field.
This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.

job_title: Senior Product Specialist Partner Solutions Architect
section_intro:
A newly created role to help Databricks create new product categories.
As Databricks accelerates its most strategic products, we are investing ahead of the curve in the partner ecosystem that helps our customers adopt them, and we are building a new specialisation function to lead that effort.
You will pioneer it across EMEA.
Reporting to: Director, Partner Field Engineering (EMEA).
As the Senior Product Specialist Partner Solutions Architect, you own how our leading System Integrator partners develop deep, market-leading expertise in Databricks' priority products:
OLTP/Postgres (Lakebase): Databricks' fully managed, Postgres-compatible operational (OLTP) database for intelligent applications
Product AI (Genie): Databricks' natural-language analytics experience, letting anyone ask questions of governed data conversationally
AI Router & Governance (Unity Gateway): Databricks' governed gateway for securely managing, monitoring and routing access to AI and large language model endpoints
Migrations & Modernisation: moving legacy data warehouses and platforms onto the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform
Turn-key Solutions: Cybersecurity (Lakewatch) and CDP (CustomerLake) with more to come
Your mandate is to take our leading partners to the highest tier of Centre-of-Excellence product specialisation on these products, and to turn them into independent, market-leading extensions of the Databricks field.
Working hand in hand with our EMEA Product Specialist team, you will carry both the deep technical narrative and the business-value and go-to-market narrative that get these products positioned, adopted and scaled through the partner channel.
This is a builder's role: you will design the blueprint for a partner product-specialist function that Databricks scales globally, starting in EMEA.
What we are trying to achieve
Databricks' priority products are seeing strong momentum across EMEA.
Lakebase is one of the fastest-growing additions to our platform, Unity Gateway is newly generally available, and AI/BI + Genie are changing how customers work with their data.
As adoption accelerates, our partners are central to helping customers realise value quickly and at scale.
Deepening partner expertise in these products is one of the most powerful levers we have to accelerate customer time-to-value, and this role exists to build that capability deliberately and ahead of demand, so our partners lead the market.
What the role owns
Building the partner specialist community (the day-to-day).
Select, enable and certify leading EMEA partners to the highest tier of product specialisation, running the enablement engine end to end: partner selection, technical upskilling to expert depth, certification and first joint customer wins.
Partnering with our Product Specialist team.
Act as the partner-side counterpart to Databricks' EMEA Product Specialists, bringing the latest product expertise to partners, connecting partner enablement to live customer opportunities, and channelling partner and customer adoption insight back to our product organisation.
Scaling specialist capacity through partners.
Grow models where specialised partners bring product-specialist capacity to joint customers, so expertise scales across the ecosystem.
Launch-partner motions.
Position specialised partners as launch partners for major product releases, signalling ecosystem trust and accelerating go-to-market at each milestone.
Thought leadership and the business-value narrative.
Author the "better-together" technical and commercial story for these products in the partner channel: reference architectures, positioning, partner offers and value framing that let partners sell and deliver independently.
Be a visible voice for partner product specialisation, internally and externally.
Building the function.
Define the operating model, the specialisation and certification criteria, the partner selection bar and the cadence, and create the template Databricks adopts to scale this function worldwide.
The impact you will have
Accelerate customer adoption and time-to-value on Databricks' priority products by putting genuine product depth into the partner channel.
Grow partner-led momentum behind our fastest-growing products, building partner capability ahead of the demand curve.
Elevate leading EMEA System Integrators to full independence on the priority products, so they operate as market leaders and true extensions of the Databricks field.
Establish a repeatable, globally scalable partner product-specialist function, proven in EMEA and exported across Databricks.
What we look for
Extensive hands-on experience with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, with genuine depth in at least two of the priority products above and the ability to get to depth quickly on the rest.
This is a senior role for an established Databricks expert.
Proven ability to build partner or field capability at scale: enablement, certification and community-building that turns others into independent experts.
Strong business-value and go-to-market instinct: able to translate technical depth into commercial positioning and partner-led market impact, and to engage partner and customer organisations at senior-executive level.
Demonstrated thought leadership: authoring technical and business content (reference architectures, solution guides, positioning, playbooks) and presenting complex products credibly to technical and executive audiences.
At least 5 years of technical pre-sales or sales-methodology experience in a consumption business model, and experience designing and delivering end-to-end data, warehousing and AI architectures.
Coding experience in a core language (Python, SQL, Java or Scala) and hands-on experience building data applications or AI agents.
The maturity to build a new function from the ground up: defining the operating model, standards and cadence, and managing multiple changing priorities across a partner ecosystem and internal teams.

section_intro:
The Solutions Architect (AI) team executes on Databricks' strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritized product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth.
They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region.
Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals.
By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position in-depth the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product.
They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.
The Solutions Architect (AI) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to the product line with specific targets accordingly.
Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that customers make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.
The impact you will have
Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on big data projects, ranging from architectural design to data engineering to model deployment
Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies and strategic sales plays across your territory, driving AI adoption
As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect building technical credibility with CAIOs, CDOs and CTOs to drive product adoption and vision.
Enable clients at scale through workshops, POC execution, and developing customer-facing collateral that increases technical knowledge and demonstrates the value of the Databricks architecture for AI and agentic workflows.
Lead the design and implementation of high-profile, high-value agentic AI use cases on Databricks, leveraging Databricks Agent Framework, AgentBricks, and other Databricks AI capabilities to accelerate production adoption and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Drive agentic AI quality and production readiness by implementing robust evaluation and monitoring strategies using MLflow, LLM-as-a-judge, custom evaluation metrics, and tracing to continuously improve agent accuracy, reliability, and performance.
Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams.
Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical use-cases.
Establish and refine the sales qualification and POC intake process, ensuring well-scoped engagements that maximize customer success and minimize friction for R&D.
Competencies & Responsibilities
10+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level ML/AI strategy and product adoption.
Experience with design and implementation of production-grade ML and generative AI applications in customer or enterprise environments
Hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions, including RAG, tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, and autonomous workflows, ideally using Databricks Agent Framework and Agent Bricks.
Strong understanding of agentic AI evaluation methodologies, including MLflow Tracing, LLM judges, custom scorers, and systematic approaches to measuring agent quality, reliability, and production performance.
Deep familiarity with using frontier models (from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI and Google Gemini), including deployment, optimisation and migration strategies as well as with machine learning, LLMs, and agentic AI workflows.
Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL, Python, Apache Spark, cloud platforms, and Lakehouse architectures and with AI tools.
Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes in AI.
Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with an understanding of cloud-native AI platforms
Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.
About Databricks

Location: Remote - Huntsville, Alabama - with up to 30% Travel
At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey.
You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks Platform in your customers.
You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability for our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage of Databricks workloads they have already selected, helping them maximize the value they get from our platform and their return on investment.

It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon.

This requires you to utilize your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate effectively with all levels of an organization.

Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to the production/go-live status of agreed-upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical experts, to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create, own, and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals

Main use cases moving from 'win' to production
Enablement/user growth plan
Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks' Lakehouse vision)
Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
Executive and operational governance

U.S. citizenship

Programming experience in Python, SQL, or Scala
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role

Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
Can travel up to 30% when needed

section_intro:
CSQ228R159
At Databricks we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Lakehouse platform.
As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play a critical role during this journey.
The DSA works across a small number of our largest or highest potential key accounts, collaborating across Databricks teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform.
As a DSA, you will help ensure customer success by driving focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate consumption on Databricks workloads that they have already selected.
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role.
It is commercial in the sense that you will be required to own and drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, owning executive relationships and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to execute upon.
This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become at least Level 200 across all Databricks products/workloads and that you become the Use Case-specific technical lead post Technical Win.
You will bring strong executive relationship management skills and high levels of technical credibility to effectively engage and communicate at all levels with an organization, in particular with a track record of building strong relationships with the customers' executives and C-suite, elevating the conversation, and helping them realize the value of Databricks.
You will report directly to a Director, Field Engineering, as part of your Business Unit's Technical GM organization.
You will play a key role in establishing the fundamental assets and best practices within the DSA team, mentoring other DSAs and wider account team members within your region, helping them develop personally, professionally and to further their careers.
The impact you will have:
Engage with the Solutions Architect to understand the full Use Case Demand Plan for prioritized customers.
Own the Post-Technical Win technical account strategy and investment plan for the majority of Databricks Use Cases within our most strategic accounts.
Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific Use Cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty/ambiguity and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks.
Be the first point of contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon Use Cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations.
Leverage both Shared Services of User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to Level 400/500 technical experts (Specialist Solution Architects and Product Specialists) to execute on the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise.
Create, own and execute a PoV as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, bringing EM/PM in to prepare Professional Services proposals.
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for New Product Innovations, Private Previews and Upgrade needs (DBR, E2 and Unity Catalog).
Build and maintain an executive level as well as a detailed programme level success plan that covers all activities of Customer, PS, Partner, SSA, Product Specialist, SA to cover the below workstreams:
Key use cases moving from 'win' to production
Enablement / user growth plan
Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of LH vision)
Organic needs for current investment Eg.
Cloud Cost control, Tuning & Optimization
Executive and operational governance
Proactively provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of consumption and customer health, covering investment status, key risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM
Development of reusable and scalable assets and mentorship of junior team members to establish the DSA team
What we look for:
8+ years in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
Experience understanding architecture related distributed data systems, specifically within one of the following:
Data Engineering technologies (e.g.
Spark, Hadoop, Kafka)
Data Warehousing (e.g.
SQL, OLTP/OLAP/DSS)
Data Science and Machine Learning technologies (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, HPO)
Comfortable managing multiple projects at once, and engaging a virtual team of subject matter experts to address any onboarding or technical challenges outside of your remit or bandwidth.
Influencing and leading teams - especially without having direct reporting line responsibility for individuals within account and leadership teams, both internally and externally
Executive Stakeholder management - experience in effectively engaging and influencing a variety of audiences (technical, non technical) at all levels of an organization with particular success in building and maintaining strong CxO level relationship
Executive escalation management - experience in resolving complex and critical escalation with senior customer and internal executives
Strategic Management Consulting - experience of conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
Building and steering to a value case - business value consulting and realization
Quota ownership, achievement and track record of great performance against objective target
Proficient in both Korean and English (Native level Korean and Business level English) verbally and in writing

Databricks is looking for a Senior Collections Analyst to own a high-volume accounts receivable (AR) portfolio in a fast-growing, usage-based SaaS business.
The role drives timely collections, reduces delinquency, protects cash flow and leads recovery on complex, high-value accounts, while helping shape credit risk decisions.
Working closely with Sales, Legal, Billing, Revenue Operations, Cash Application and Finance leadership to resolve disputes, billing gaps and customer escalations, the role has a measurable impact on DSO and bad debt exposure and requires regular overlap with EMEA and PST business hours.
Job Description
Own end-to-end portfolio collections and recovery strategies, partnering cross-functionally to resolve high-value escalations, influence credit risk decisions, and drive measurable performance across DSO, aging buckets, and bad debt exposure.
Design and run recovery strategies for accounts that are structurally delinquent or high-risk.
Lead cross-functional escalation forums for disputed high-value accounts.
Present portfolio-level risk trends and actionable insights to Finance leadership.
Recommend credit limit changes, payment term changes or account holds based on behavioral analytics.
Work with Legal on pre-legal actions and structured recovery plans.
Assess creditworthiness, establish risk controls, and lead complex recoveries to protect working capital and minimize bad debt exposure.
Build scalable reporting models that give clear visibility into aging, dispute velocity and payment predictability.
Flag worsening payment patterns, and provide quarterly bad debt reserve inputs with documented risk rationale for each account.
Act as the subject matter expert on usage-based billing disputes and contract interpretation.

Find the systemic billing, consumption or process gaps that cause repeat delinquency.
Work with Billing and Revenue Operations to put corrective frameworks in place.
Perform detailed account reconciliations in NetSuite to keep AR accurate and audit-ready.
Help standardize collections processes so they are faster and can scale, and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for new or improved systems.

Location: Germany (remote or from a Databricks office - anywhere in Germany) Languages: Fluent German and business-level English
At Databricks, we build the platform that makes data and AI usable across an entire organization.
More and more of our customers in Germany - public sector, critical infrastructure (KRITIS), financial services, healthcare, defence and industry - need to keep control over where their data lives and who can access it.
They want the full power of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform without giving up data residency, jurisdictional control or the option to switch providers.
As a Solutions Architect for Digital Sovereignty, you are the technical lead for this motion in Germany.
You design sovereign data and AI architectures with customers, run proofs of concept end to end, and help our sovereign cloud partners and account teams turn a proven pattern into production workloads.
The impact you will have
Act as the trusted technical advisor on digital sovereignty for strategic and regulated customers across Germany, from the first conversation with the CIO/CISO through to production.
Design and validate sovereign reference architectures
Run complex proofs of concept and pilots - performance, scalability, security and network connectivity tests with different data volumes - and translate the results into clear go/no-go recommendations.
Work hand in hand with sovereign cloud and storage partners: joint solution design, enablement of partner technical teams, co-selling and joint customer workshops.
Position Databricks clearly in the sovereignty discussion - CLOUD Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA, BSI C5, EU Data Act, open formats and exit strategies - and articulate how our open architecture reduces lock-in compared with competing approaches.
Feed field requirements back to Databricks Product and Engineering, and collaborate with Legal, Security and Compliance on customer questions.
Build repeatable assets: reference architectures, demos, PoC playbooks, Terraform/automation templates and customer-facing collateral in German and English.
Build Databricks' visibility on sovereignty in the German market through workshops, meetups, webinars and conference talks.
Turn customer conversations into working prototypes fast, using AI-assisted development to build demos in hours rather than weeks.
What we look for
Fluent German and business-level English.
Both are used daily with customers, partners and internally.
Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solution architecture or consulting, including complex enterprise customer interactions across the full sales lifecycle.
Hands-on experience with data platforms in at least one major public cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP), ideally including Apache Spark and/or Databricks.
Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure: networking (private connectivity, VPN, private endpoints), identity and access management, encryption and key management (BYOK/HYOK).
Experience with object storage and open table formats (S3-compatible storage such as MinIO, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) and with secure data sharing patterns.
Good working knowledge of the regulatory and sovereignty landscape in Germany and the EU (e.g.
GDPR, CLOUD Act implications, NIS2, DORA, BSI C5, KRITIS) and the ability to discuss it confidently with CISOs, data protection officers and procurement.
Ability to drive technical and business conversations with C-level executives, orchestrate cross-functional and partner teams, and influence outcomes toward long-term customer success.
Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL; infrastructure-as-code experience (e.g.
Terraform) is a plus.
Daily, fluent use of AI tools in your own work.
Coding assistants and agents are part of how you operate, not something you try out occasionally.
Able to vibe-code a demo: assemble a credible, working prototype for a specific customer problem with AI assistance, and recognize where the output still needs your own judgment.
Experience working with or for European / sovereign cloud providers, public sector or regulated industries is a strong plus.
Judgment to prioritize the right use cases and investments, and to navigate a competitive landscape.
Willingness to travel within Germany for customer and partner meetings.
Why this role
You will shape a new, strategically important motion for Databricks in Germany and EMEA - building on a proof of concept that has already delivered results.
You will work at the intersection of data and AI, cloud infrastructure, regulation and partnerships.
You will collaborate closely with Field Engineering leadership, Product, and our partner ecosystem.
About Databricks

job_title: Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace
section_intro:
Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace
P-1630
section_about:
Every product Databricks ships has to be priced, contracted, rated and billed before it can earn a dollar.
The Money organization builds the systems that make this happen, at hyperscaler scale and across every major cloud.
We built the world's only cross-cloud integrated rating engine in-house, and it now rates billions of dollars in revenue.
Our next goal is bigger: a fully automated, zero-touch order-to-cash flow where the platform is the source of truth for accounts, contracts and subscriptions, and Month End Close needs little or no human intervention.
As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization that owns this commercial engine from start to finish.
You will set the product and technology strategy for how Databricks makes money.
You will be the engineering voice Finance, Product and GTM leaders turn to for strategic decisions.
You will also build the leadership bench that lets the organization keep scaling.
Speed is critical.
Databricks keeps inventing new ways to sell: commit and pay-as-you-go, marketplaces, conditional benefits, strategic partnerships and new clouds and regions.
The commerce engine either makes each of these fast and safe to launch, or it becomes the bottleneck.
You will make sure it is the former.
What you'll own
The org covers six commercial domains:
Pricing configuration: SKUs, multipliers, price-change processes, deal desk and discounting
Orders and contracts: from negotiated quote to order to signed customer contract
Subscriptions: commit, pay-as-you-go and proof-of-concept subscriptions, plus how contracts are tied to payment methods
Rating: applying each customer's negotiated price, discounts and conditional benefits to ingested usage to compute the bill
Billing: commit drawdown, invoicing, Month End Close and related financial processes
Marketplace: third-party data and solutions, available seamlessly to Databricks customers
The impact you'll have
Set and communicate the vision.
Write the multi-year product and technology strategy for the commerce engine, toward a zero-touch order-to-cash flow and a next-generation billing architecture.
Present it clearly to executives, Finance and Product leaders, so that strategy and architecture decisions come to you by default.
Own business outcomes across orgs, not just your team's part.
Revenue-critical programs routinely span 100+ people across Finance, Product, IT, Accounts and GTM.
You will own the full outcome: dependency plans with clear owners, timelines, quality bars and escalation triggers, raised early in leadership forums so cross-org risks don't become executive surprises.
Make commercialization a platform capability.
Build reusable building blocks (credits, commits, conditional benefits, marketplace and partner billing) so that new pricing models and routes to market ship in weeks, not quarters.
Treat foundations as seriously as features.
Hold reliability, correctness, SOX and compliance readiness, security, cost visibility and operational load to the same standard as product launches.
Billing errors should be structurally impossible, operational work should grow more slowly than revenue, and postmortems should actually lead to change.
Partner deeply with Business & Finance.
Turn accounting, close and compliance requirements into engineering design.
Keep improving the Month End Close timeline and audit readiness, and earn the trust of Technical Accounting, Revenue Ops and Strategy & Execution leaders.
Build a team of leaders.
Grow the organization from one with a large group of direct-report engineers to one led by strong engineering managers and tech-lead managers, with clear subteams, domain boundaries and named owners.
Coach managers to be great people leaders, give specific feedback and career plans, and recognize high-performing teams publicly.
Hire like a founder.
Act as the hiring owner for the Money Bellevue site.
Source and close senior engineering and management talent, put the company first when placing hires across Money teams, and help raise the Databricks engineering hiring bar.
What we're looking for
12+ years in software engineering, including 6+ years leading engineering organizations and managing managers, ideally in billing, payments, commerce, fintech or other systems where errors directly cost revenue or create regulatory exposure
A track record of delivering large, revenue-critical, cross-functional programs (for example, replacing a billing or rating system, migrating a source of truth, or automating order-to-cash) on time and with high quality
Technical depth in distributed systems and large-scale data pipelines.
You can discuss correctness, idempotency, reconciliation and data lineage with tech leads, and you know when to coach and when to decide.
Fluency in order-to-cash and finance concepts: pricing and discounting, contracts, revenue recognition, invoicing, month-end close, SOX controls.
You have earned trust as a partner to Finance and Accounting leaders.
Strong product judgment: you can spot gaps in the commercial platform, shape requirements with Product, and make build-versus-buy decisions that pay off over time
Clear, confident communication of strategy to executives, plus the ability to influence peers in Product, Finance, IT and GTM without direct authority
Experience scaling an organization quickly while keeping a high hiring bar, developing strong leaders and engineers, and keeping them engaged on internal platform work
BS in Computer Science or a related field; MS preferred.
Experience with Kafka, Apache Spark, Delta Lake or cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.
Why this role
You will run the engine behind the revenue of one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world.
The problems involve hard distributed-systems correctness at scale, high financial and compliance stakes, and a direct, visible link to company growth.
